title: ever ARLET|Long Sleeve High Stretch Velvet Tea Length Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your formal look with this long-sleeve velvet tea-length dress, designed for wedding guests or any special occasion. The soft, high-stretch velvet fabric ensures both comfort and a flattering fit, while the elegant tea-length silhouette offers a timeless appeal. Perfect for cooler events, this dress combines luxurious texture with sophisticated style, making it a standout piece in your formal wardrobe.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: No zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, without lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises velvet.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
